name: serialize the solved grid to a file with exact row formatting
definition: Write the 9 rows to a file as 9 lines each of 9 space-separated digits and nothing else.
failure_mode: Extra whitespace, wrong formatting, or partial rows breaks the flattened comparison.

name: solve a periodic-scheduling maximum-gap problem
definition: compute the largest consecutive gap with no scheduled periodic event among three schedules with distinct cycle lengths, using number-theoretic / discrete reasoning rather than a point estimate.
failure_mode: an off-by-one or flawed covering argument yields the wrong number
